people.name: Adonijah
people.line: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne

people.name: Nathan
people.line: Prophet during the reigns of David and Solomon.

translations.web: Nathan said, “My lord, king, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne?’
translations.bsb: “My lord the king,” said Nathan, “did you say, ‘Adonijah will reign after me, and he will sit on my throne’?
translations.kjv: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
translations.asv: And Nathan said, My lord, O king, hast thou said, Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit upon my throne?
